$comment: Explicitly reviewed advisories that are reachable only from developer build tooling, never from code shipped to a player. Every entry must name the dependency path, state whether the vulnerable code path is reachable, and carry a reviewBy date. Anything not listed here fails the gate, so a new advisory can never be absorbed silently. See docs/privacy-security.md.

reviewed.advisory: image-size ICNS/JXL/HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops
reviewed.justification: Metro measures image assets while bundling the native app on a developer machine. It never runs on a player device and is not part of the web runtime or the shipped iOS/Android bundle. The parser only sees asset files committed to this repository, so there is no untrusted input path.
reviewed.fixNotes: Every published image-size version is in the vulnerable range, so no upgrade resolves this. npm proposes downgrading expo 57 to 53, a semver-major downgrade that would break the verified native Link build. Re-check for a patched image-size release at the review date.

reviewed.advisory: uuid missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf is provided
reviewed.justification: The xcode package rewrites Xcode project files during iOS prebuild on a developer machine. It calls only uuid.v4(); the advisory concerns v3/v5/v6 called with an explicit buf argument, so the vulnerable code path is not reached.
reviewed.fixNotes: Patched in uuid >= 11.1.1, but the fix lives inside a transitive dependency of Expo's own tooling. Forcing an override into xcode's internals risks breaking iOS project generation for an unreachable code path. Adopt it when Expo updates xcode upstream.
